name: Plan a wide turn
description: Look ahead, leave clearance and link three original Hangar gates.

steps.text: Follow the original Hangar gates. Before a corner, reduce speed and look toward the next opening. Bank with roll and guide the nose with yaw.
steps.title: Plan the corner

steps.text: Fly through gate 1. Approach its centre with room to turn afterwards.
steps.title: Approach gate 1

steps.text: Turn toward gate 2. Use a gentle bank; avoid sliding into the outside wall.
steps.title: Bank toward gate 2

steps.text: Link the turn into gate 3. Follow the next-gate marker instead of staring at the gate behind you.
steps.title: Link the turn into gate 3

steps.text: Choose an open floor area, level out and land gently.
steps.title: Land in an open area
